_comment: App-icon targets as the platforms' guides state them. These are facts about a platform, not about an
app, which is why they live in the engine: an app's logo config names a target by key and says where
the file goes. `size` is the square's edge in pixels. `layer` is what the file holds: `full` (the
motif over the background colour, opaque), `foreground` (the motif alone, transparent), `background`
(the background colour alone) or `monochrome` (the motif's silhouette in white, transparent).
`safe_circle` is the diameter, as a fraction of `size`, of the centred circle no platform mask ever
clips: every pixel of the motif stays inside it. `viewport` is the centred fraction of the square a
device shows before its own mask, and `masks` the shapes the guides sheet previews it under. A new
target gets an entry here, with the URLs and the date read.

_note: 1024 x 1024 px, square; the system masks the corners, so the file is unmasked. Expo: 'Make sure the
icon fills the whole square, with no rounded corners or other transparent pixels'. Apple gives no
safe area in figures, only 'keep primary content centered', so the safe circle is the inscribed one;
how large the motif sits inside it is the app's `fill`. Apple publishes no corner curve; the guides
preview approximates it with a superellipse.
512 x 512 px, 32-bit PNG, sRGB, full square; Play applies the mask itself, a corner radius of 30 % of
the icon size, and its own shadow. A transparent asset shows Play's UI colour, so the file is opaque.
The inscribed circle lies inside a square rounded by 30 %, so it is the safe circle.
Every layer is 108 x 108 dp; the outer 18 dp per side are reserved for the mask and for parallax, so
a device shows the inner 72 dp. The logo 'must not exceed 66x66 dp', the zone 'never clipped by a
shaped mask defined by an OEM' (Figure 4 draws it as a 66 dp circle). Expo asks for at least 512 px;
1024 px stands for 108 dp.
Same 108 dp square as the foreground; Expo: 'Make sure that it has the same dimensions as your
foreground image'. An app that sets only `backgroundColor` in its Expo config needs no file.
The themed-icon layer (Android 13+): one layer the launcher tints from the wallpaper, so only its
alpha counts. Same 108 dp square and 66 dp safe zone as the foreground (Figure 6).
Expo: 'Use a 1024x1024 image' with 'a transparent background'. Android 12+: an icon without an icon
background 'must be 288x288 dp and fit within a circle 192 dp in diameter'; everything outside the
circle is masked. 192 / 288 = 2/3.
Square, at least 8 x 8 px; Google 'recommend[s] using a favicon that's larger than 48x48px', so 96.
Browsers draw it unmasked; opaque so it reads on light and dark tab bars alike.

_source: No platform guide: the app draws this file itself (a header beside its name), so no device mask
applies. 256 px covers a 32 pt mark at @3x with headroom for a larger one.
_note: The motif alone on a transparent square, edge to edge, for an app's own UI. With the safe circle
the whole square, an app's fill of 1.0 puts the motif's bounding circle at the file's edge.
